author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a rounded frame with thin top and bottom perforated strips and a large picture area; reads as a film frame like the reference. The rejected drawing had chamfered corners and heavy boxes. A first attempt with floating dot perforations forced thick strips and a thin picture area (read as a server rack) and was discarded.
omissions: The floating dash perforations become ticks joining edge and divider (a dash cannot keep 8 units above and below inside an 8-tall strip).
drawing_plan: SQUARE frame x 6..42, y 6..42 with r3 corners; dividers y 14 and 34; ticks at x 17 and 31 in both strips.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'film': frame with strip dividers and perforation ticks.
